Detailed Description

template<class TimeUnits = std::chrono::milliseconds>
class beerocks::net::TimerImpl< TimeUnits >

This class is an implementation of the Timer interface and a C++ wrapper for the timerfd_create(2) and timerfd_settime(2) system calls. See the Linux manual page for extended information.

This implementation uses timerfd_create() to create a timer object that delivers timer expiration notifications via a file descriptor.

◆ m_descriptor

template<class TimeUnits = std::chrono::milliseconds>
FileDescriptorImpl beerocks::net::TimerImpl< TimeUnits >::m_descriptor
private

File descriptor implementation (i.e.: wrapper to int fd that closes descriptor on destructor). To "favor composition over inheritance", the timer implementation does not extend the FileDescriptor interface but aggregates this wrapper and delegates the calls to method fd() to it.
